defect.repair: Mask fertilizer availability only for colliding WATER actors in a private admission view before invoking the exact donor. Keep original action rows, observation, shed and other actors unchanged.

engine.loader: Loads the complete pinned interpreter. Only its external seed-helper import is supplied by compiling the exact resolve_episode_seed function from pinned utils.py. No substitute transition function.

mutation_controls.unit: failed assertions/subcases in EACH normal and optimized 44-test run; no errors or skips
